message.content: The 19th‑century sculpture most often cited as the era’s iconic masterpiece is **“The Kiss” (Le Baiser) by Auguste Rodin** (1889).  Its dramatic, sensuous form and the way it captures a fleeting moment of intimacy made it a defining work of the period and a lasting symbol of modern sculpture.
